sourcedDescription: ACI has confirmed a token airdrop, with 30,000,000 $ACI set aside for the current testnet phase. Participation is free. The only thing you need is Sepolia test ETH, which you claim from a faucet at no cost, and rewards come from completing on-chain activity and quests rather than buying anything.
tagline_en: ACI has confirmed a token airdrop, with 30,000,000 $ACI set aside for the current testnet phase. Participation is free. The only thing you need is Sepolia test ETH, which you claim from a faucet at no cost, and rewards come from completing on-chain activity and quests rather than buying anything.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Sepolia Testnet ETH
sourcedSteps.body: You need Sepolia ETH to pay gas and swap for ACI test tokens. Claim it free from a faucet such as Alchemy (recommended).

sourcedSteps.title: Connect Your Wallet to ACI
sourcedSteps.body: Open the ACI testnet , connect MetaMask, and switch the network to Sepolia. Approve the connection request to link your wallet.

sourcedSteps.title: Swap ETH for ACI Test Tokens
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the “wallet” tab and swap Sepolia ETH for $ACI. Verify the missions you plan to complete first, then swap enough ACI to cover staking and any mission requirements.

sourcedSteps.title: Stake ACI to Unlock Missions
sourcedSteps.body: On the staking page, stake your ACI tokens. The mission board stays locked until you stake, so this step is required before you can start earning toward your allocation.

sourcedSteps.title: Complete Missions and Zealy Quests
sourcedSteps.body: Work through the on-chain missions in the ACI app, then visit the Zealy quest board for social and community tasks. Each completed mission unlocks its ACI reward.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Creator Program
sourcedSteps.body: ACI announced a Creator Program on May 28, 2026, with a 400 USDT reward pool for content creators. If you post about the project, follow ACI on X and submit your entry to compete for a share. This step is optional and does not affect your testnet allocation.
